assistant.howtoAudio: To download audio/MP3: in the Add Download dialog, open the Audio tab and pick a bitrate — it saves as an .mp3 in the Music folder.
assistant.howtoCookies: For videos that need a login: Settings → Browser & Cookies → pick your browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Brave), or add a cookies.txt file. DOVIRA never stores your passwords.
assistant.howtoDiagnose: Something isn't working? Settings → Setup & diagnostics → Run diagnostics. It checks the Local API, yt-dlp, aria2, the browser extension and your download folder, and tells you what to do — in plain language.
assistant.howtoDrm: DRM-protected sites (Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, Spotify) can't be downloaded — their videos are encrypted and DOVIRA never breaks DRM. Use the site's own offline/download button instead.
assistant.howtoExtension: To connect the browser extension: Settings → Setup & diagnostics → Browser extension — follow the guided steps (copy the folder path, load it unpacked in Chrome with Developer mode on, paste the pairing token). The extension checks in with the app every minute.
assistant.howtoExtensionSetup: To set up the extension in Chrome: 1) Open chrome://extensions and turn Developer mode on (top-right). 2) Click Load unpacked and pick the extension/dist folder (in the installed app: resources\extension). 3) In the app, go to Settings → Browser extension and click Pair extension — the Options page opens with the token already filled in; it saves automatically and shows Paired. Then hover any video to see the Download button.
assistant.howtoFetch: Fetching a video takes about 10 seconds — yt-dlp first has to load the page and solve YouTube's checks. That's normal. The app pre-warms yt-dlp at startup and caches the result for 5 minutes, so the same video opens instantly the second time.
assistant.howtoFolder: Downloads go to {dir}. To change it: Settings → Download folder → Browse. New downloads go there; already-downloaded files stay where they are.
assistant.howtoGrabber: To grab every file from a page: click Site Grabber in the sidebar, paste the page URL, and pick the files to download.
assistant.howtoResume: To pause or resume: use the Pause / Resume buttons on a download card, or Pause all / Resume all in the toolbar. A stopped download resumes from where it stopped.
assistant.howtoScheduler: To start downloads at a set time: Settings → Scheduler → turn it on and pick a time. The PC must be on and DOVIRA running at that time.
assistant.howtoSmart: Smart features live in Settings → Smart features: AI File Organizer, Smart filenames, Duplicate Detection, Smart Download, and the optional local AI model. Each has its own switch.
assistant.howtoSpeed: To limit speed: Settings → Speed limit. Set KB/s (0 = unlimited). It applies to new downloads and ones already running.
assistant.howtoSubtitles: To get subtitles: in the Add Download dialog, turn on Subtitles and pick a language. You can also embed them into the video or save a separate .srt file.
assistant.howtoUpdate: To update yt-dlp: Settings → Engines → Update next to yt-dlp. A newer yt-dlp fixes most site errors (403, unsupported links).
